steps.title: Prepare RNA priming mixture
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube add RNase‑free water (to bring total volume to ≤4 µL), purified RNA (10 pg–5 µg; typically 200 ng for soil extract), and either random hexamers (50 µM, Thermo Scientific Catalog #N8080127) or a gene‑specific primer (2 µM). Mix gently and spin down.

steps.title: Denature RNA primers
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 65 °C for 5 min in a thermocycler, then place on ice (or at ≤4 °C in the cycler) for at least 1 min.

steps.title: Prepare reverse‑transcription master mix
steps.instruction: In a separate tube combine the following (volumes not specified): 5× Reaction buffer, dNTP mix (10 mM each), 0.1 M DTT (Thermo Fisher Catalog #707265ML, CAS 3483‑12‑3), RNaseOUT™ (40 U/µL, Thermo Fisher Catalog #10777019), BSA (20 µg/µL, Thermo Fisher Catalog #B14), and SuperScript™ IV RT (200 U/µL, Thermo Fisher Catalog #18091050). Optionally add additional DTT solution. Mix gently.

steps.title: Add RT master mix to RNA
steps.instruction: Add the reverse‑transcription master mix to each RNA‑primer tube, mix gently, and spin down.

steps.title: Reverse transcription incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at 23 °C for 10 min if random hexamers are used (skip if a gene‑specific primer is used), then at 50 °C for 1–3 h, then at 80 °C for 10 min. Chill on ice.

steps.title: Prepare second‑strand synthesis mix
steps.instruction: In a new tube combine 1 µL DNA Polymerase I reaction buffer, 0.75 µL DNA Polymerase I (10 U/µL, Thermo Fisher Catalog #EP0041), 0.2 µL DNA Polymerase I (additional), 3.05 µL RNase H (Thermo Fisher Catalog #18021071), 5 µL RNase‑free water (Carl Roth Catalog #T143.1, CAS 7732‑18‑5), and the cDNA template. Mix gently.

steps.title: Second‑strand synthesis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at 15 °C for 2 h, then at 75 °C for 10 min to deactivate enzymes.

steps.title: Purify cDNA
steps.instruction: Purify the reaction by phenol/chloroform extraction followed by ethanol precipitation, or alternatively use a PCR purification kit.
